scripts.build: npm run version:sync && node scripts/update-catalog-cache.mjs && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/prepare-static-dist.mjs
scripts.bundle:windows: npm run version:sync && tauri build --bundles nsis,msi
scripts.bundle:macos: npm run version:sync && tauri build --bundles app,dmg
scripts.bundle:linux: npm run version:sync && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb
scripts.check:scripts: node --check scripts/official-proxy.mjs && node --check scripts/web-server.mjs && node --check scripts/sync-version.mjs && node --check api/catalog.mjs && node --check api/song.mjs && node --check api/audio.mjs && node --check api/audio/[id].mjs
scripts.check:fast: npm run version:check && npm test && npm run check:scripts
scripts.check: npm run check:fast && npm run typecheck
scripts.ci: npm run check:fast && npm run build
